attributes.bio: Nazarii Sovsun is a cultural critic, activist and journalist. He was born in 1988 in Kharkiv and lives in Kyiv. He is a member of the Freedom March, which has been campaigning for drug policy reform in Ukraine since 2005. From 2008 to 2014, he worked at the Visual Culture Research Center. Before the full-scale invasion, he was part of the Схема team. In August 2023, he organized the exhibition “The Threshold of Pain” at the War Museum in Kyiv, which was dedicated to the traumas of war.
